notes.title: New Patch is Up
notes.content:
Hey paisanos, a new Slinki patch was released, here's what's fixed:
[list]
[*]Pause menu now works properly with both a mouse and a gamepad plugged in. Users should no longer have problems with not being able to use the menu.
[*]Several level glitches and bugs were fixed.
[*]Grab areas are now significantly more accurate.
[*]Fixed some instances of the walking on the ground vfx being shown in the wrong time.
[*]Hardcore mode shall no longer be referred to as "Hardore" mode. 
[/list]

notes.title: Linux Build Problems
notes.content:
I would just like to announce that we're having some unforeseen problems with the Linux build. We're currently working towards fixing the following issues:

[list]
[*] Pure black landscape
[*] Saves aren't working
[/list]

As soon as we have these fixed we'll be sure to let you know. We hope you'll enjoy Slinki :)
